archetype: The Ink Bowl's caller: an original arena announcer. A gravel-voiced, high-energy stadium caller in his forties, a raspy baritone that rises to a roar on the big moments; punchy, playful swagger, holds his big vowels ("GOOOAL!"), drops a Japanese hype word now and then (sugoi, yatta, ikuzo, kanpeki, subarashii, kita). English.
voiceDesign: Male, forties, deep raspy baritone with gravel, very high energy, booming stadium public-address announcer, crisp diction, big dynamic range: conversational at the low end, a full-throated roar at the top. Clean studio recording, no music, no crowd, no reverb.
processing: Trimmed to the voice (20 ms before it, 120 ms after), 90 Hz high-pass, 11 kHz low-pass; levelled as the Rift's announcer is: the loudest 400 ms (BS.1770 momentary) at -13 LUFS, peaks under -1.5 dBFS; 48 kHz mono AAC, 80 kb/s.
